description: AI-powered business card scanner that captures images and extracts contact information automatically using Google's Gemini AI. This component allows users to quickly digitize business card details by either taking a photo or uploading an existing image, then processing it with AI to extract relevant contact information.

pages.name: BusinessCardScannerComponent
pages.description: This modal dialog provides an interface for scanning business cards. Users can capture new images using their device's camera, upload existing images, and then initiate an AI scan to extract contact details. It's designed for quick and efficient digitization of physical business cards into digital contacts.

buttons.label: Toggle Camera
buttons.description: Switches between the front and back camera on mobile devices. This is useful for finding the best angle and lighting to capture the business card clearly.
when_to_use: When the current camera view is not optimal for capturing the business card.
If you need to switch from the front-facing camera to the rear-facing camera (or vice-versa) to get a better shot.

buttons.label: Capture
buttons.description: Takes a photo of the business card currently displayed in the camera view. This image will then be used for AI processing.
when_to_use: When you have positioned the business card clearly within the on-screen frame and are ready to take the picture for scanning.

buttons.label: Scan
buttons.description: Initiates the AI processing of the captured or uploaded business card image to automatically extract contact information such as name, company, phone, email, and address.
when_to_use: After successfully capturing a new business card image.
After uploading an existing business card image from your device.
To automatically extract contact details from the image.

buttons.label: Retake
buttons.description: Discards the currently captured image and reactivates the camera, allowing you to take a new photo of the business card.
when_to_use: When the previously captured image is blurry, poorly lit, or the business card was not positioned correctly.
If you want to try capturing the card again for better quality.

buttons.label: Upload Image
buttons.description: Allows you to select and upload an existing image of a business card from your device's storage for AI processing, instead of taking a new photo.
when_to_use: When you already have a photo of a business card saved on your phone or computer.
If your device's camera is not working or you prefer to use a pre-existing image.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're having trouble, ensure the business card is placed on a flat surface with good, even lighting. Position the card within the on-screen overlay frame. You can either use the 'Capture' button to take a new photo or 'Upload Image' to select one from your device. Once an image is ready, click 'Scan' to process it with AI.
common_tasks: Scanning a business card: Place the card in the camera's view, ensure it fits the frame, click 'Capture', then click 'Scan' to extract data.
Using an existing image: Click 'Upload Image', navigate to and select the business card photo from your device, then click 'Scan'.
Improving image quality: If the scan fails or data is incorrect, click 'Retake' to capture a clearer photo, or adjust lighting and card position.
Switching cameras: On mobile devices, click 'Toggle Camera' to switch between front and rear cameras for the best angle.
Extracting data: After capturing or uploading an image, always click the 'Scan' button to initiate the AI-powered data extraction.
troubleshooting: Problem: Scan results are inaccurate or missing data → Solution: Ensure the business card is well-lit, flat, and not blurry. Retake the photo, making sure the entire card is within the frame and text is clear. Avoid glare.
Problem: Camera is not working → Solution: Check your device's privacy settings to ensure the application has permission to access the camera. Try restarting the application or your device.

Problem: 'Scan' button is disabled → Solution: You must first capture an image using the 'Capture' button or upload one using 'Upload Image'. The 'Scan' button becomes active only when an image is ready for processing.
help_guidance.getting_started: To get started, place a business card on a flat, well-lit surface. Open the Business Card Scanner. Position your device's camera over the card so it fits within the on-screen guide. Tap 'Capture' to take the photo. If the photo is clear, tap 'Scan' to let the AI extract the contact details. If the photo is blurry or incomplete, tap 'Retake' and try again.
